findings.statement: Current sanitizer claims refused float values are recorded bit for bit. Distinct IEEE754 NaN payloads 7ff8000000000001 and7ff8000000000002 both normalize to {"$float_hex":"nan"} and identical encoded bytes. A finite float also aliases its caller-supplied tag mapping. These are pre-hash normalization collisions, not SHA attacks.
findings.recommended_action: Narrow the guarantee to the declared normalized representation, or use an injective typed binary encoding if original float bits/type are required. Do not infer raw reconstruction from current tags.

findings.statement: An entry labelled active for unterminated-string syntax stores negative fixture table = {'Λ': 1}, which Python AST parsing accepts. findings.recommended_action: Retain historical catalog as evidence; derive separately versioned runnable negative and valid near-miss cases before using any entry as a detector or repair rule.
